operating_notes.text: Board recommended a final dividend of ₹0.80 per equity share of ₹2 face value (40%) for FY26, payable within 30 days of AGM if approved.
FY26 raw material cost rose 134.6% to ₹876.34 Cr against revenue growth of 77.3%.
Board approved up to ₹150 Cr equity investment, ₹100 Cr unsecured loan and ₹100 Cr guarantees/SBLC for wholly owned subsidiary Taang Kaam Industries SA to set up a processing factory in Burkina Faso.

CBE was 30% of the 71.4% CBE-plus-stearin contribution in Q1FY27, with the balance stearin.
Export:domestic revenue mix was 60:40 in Q1FY27, against 55-60% export in the year-ago quarter.
Other income of ₹16 Cr in Q1FY27 included ₹13 Cr of forex gains and ₹3 Cr of FDR interest.

timeline.summary: On April 20, 2026, Manorama Industries announced that shareholders approved raising up to ₹500 Cr via QIP or other modes through a postal ballot.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹391.34 Cr (+68.1% YoY), net profit ₹52.46 Cr (+31.0% YoY).
Manorama Industries reported Q4 FY26 standalone revenue of ₹382.3 Cr (+64.2% YoY) and PAT of ₹59.5 Cr (+40.8% YoY).
Manorama Industries Limited uploaded Q4 & FY26 earnings conference call audio recording on May 12, 2026, via its website.
Manorama Industries detailed a ₹460 Cr capex plan and targeted 25-30% revenue growth during its Q4FY26 earnings call.
On 14 August 2026 Manorama told its Q1FY27 call revenue had risen 39.5% YoY to ₹404 Cr and PAT 67.6% to ₹79 Cr, and guided FY27 capex of ₹225-250 Cr within a ₹460 Cr programme.
Shareholders approved Dr. Rohini Tiwari (DIN: 11924749) as Non-Executive Independent Director via remote e-voting on October 18, 2026, with 99.9994% voting in favor.
